### Page note: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/road-safety-statistics-data-tables
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** Road safety statistics: data tables - GOV.UK  
URL: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/road-safety-statistics-data-tables  

**Evidence**  
- The page lists all published road safety statistical tables for Great Britain.  
- **Table RAS0501:** “Drivers involved by sex, age and road user type” – ODS file (94 KB) – link: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a639987e2d191f0bc8b6ef3/ras0501.ods  
- **Table RAS0502:** “Vehicles involved and involvement rates” – ODS file – link: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a6399ea9a419980593b2be1/ras0502.ods  
- **Table RAS0503:** “Vehicle type and manoeuvre” – ODS file – link: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a6399ff9a419980593b2be2/ras0503.ods  
- (List continues for RAS0504‑RAS0507, RAS0601‑RAS0703, etc.)  

The page also includes meta‑data:  
- Publication date: 24 June 2021 (first published).  
- Latest update: 30 July 2026.  
- Update history entries with dates and brief notes (e.g., “Data tables updated for Reported road casualties Great Britain, final results: 2025”).  
- Links to download all tables in a ZIP file: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a873e258346e5bc7c6db222/ras-all-tables-excel.zip.  

**Coverage**  
- This page covers the **entire catalogue of road safety statistical tables** published by the Department for Transport for Great Britain.  
- It lists the table identifiers, descriptive titles, file format (ODS), file size, and download link for each table.  
- The page does **not** contain any tabular data or specific incident counts.  
- The list is complete as provided on the page; no rows of data are present within this page.

**Missing**  
- **Female driver fatalities by transport type for the year 2015** (or any other detailed casualty data).  
- **Any breakdown of fatality counts** (by sex, age, road user type) for specific years.  
- **Specific categories or counts** required to determine the category with the fewest female driver fatalities in 2015.

**Next links**  
| Missing Field | Suggested next page (link) | Reason |
|---------------|---------------------------|--------|
| Female driver fatality counts for 2015 by category | RAS0501 (Drivers involved by sex, age and road user type) – https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a639987e2d191f0bc8b6ef3/ras0501.ods | This table specifically reports drivers by sex, age, and road user type, which is the data needed to identify fatality counts for female drivers in 2015. |
| Detailed fatality definitions and categories | RAS0204 (Enhanced severity and injury type) – https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a6911a50825cc51a6c37c4d/ras0204.ods | Provides severity classification that may be needed to isolate fatal cases. |
